artifactText: {"schemaVersion":1,"findings":[{"id":"sql-injection-in-invoice-query","title":"Unsafely interpolated customer input enables SQL injection","severity":"critical","location":"Lines 8-10, where req.query.customer is embedded in the SQL template literal.","evidence":"The query is built as `SELECT id, total FROM invoices WHERE customer = '${req.query.customer}'` and then passed directly to `db.query(sql)`. No parameter binding or validation is present.","repair":"Use a parameterized query supported by the database driver, for example `db.query('SELECT id, total FROM invoices WHERE customer = ?', [req.query.customer])`, and validate the expected customer identifier format before querying.","confidence":"high"},{"id":"path-traversal-in-download-route","title":"Download path can escape the intended data directory","severity":"high","location":"Lines 14-16, where path.join(DATA_ROOT, req.query.name) is sent to res.sendFile.","evidence":"`path.join(DATA_ROOT, req.query.name)` normalizes traversal segments such as `../`; no canonical-path containment check or filename allowlist confirms that the resulting path remains under `/srv/app/downloads`.","repair":"Accept only validated relative filenames or identifiers, resolve the candidate path with `path.resolve`, and reject it unless it begins with the resolved data-root path plus the path separator. Prefer mapping an allowlisted file ID to a server-controlled filename.","confidence":"high"},{"id":"command-injection-in-diagnostics","title":"Untrusted host input is executed by a shell command","severity":"critical","location":"Lines 19-23, specifically line 20 using exec with req.body.host.","evidence":"`exec(`ping -c 1 ${req.body.host}`)` interpolates request-controlled input into a shell command. Shell metacharacters in `req.body.host` can alter the command executed by the server process.","repair":"Avoid shell execution: use `execFile` or `spawn` with a fixed executable and argument array, such as `execFile('ping', ['-c', '1', validatedHost], ...)`. Strictly validate host input as an IP address or constrained hostname before invocation.","confidence":"high"}],"summary":"The supplied routes contain source-grounded SQL injection, path traversal, and OS command injection risks because request-controlled values are used directly in SQL, filesystem paths, and a shell command."}
